rows.grounds: accusative object of invocation and worship

items.question: Should the invoked goddess be worshipped there itself endowed with powers?
premises: Invoke the goddess at that place.
items.inference: Ritual worship follows invocation at the same site with the empowered goddess.
uncertainties: āvāhya may be read as absolutive or participle.
śaktibhiḥ may modify the goddess or the worship.
items.plain_english: Having invoked the goddess there, one should worship her there itself, endowed with powers.
